name: Hotta Sumire
source:
A woman who is working at a fitness club in her neighborhood. She divorced with her cheating husband right after giving birth to her son Takao, who is currently 3 years old. She's raising him on her own. Has a fresh and boyish look, but is earnest and straightforward. Is overflowing with maternal instincts, and thus she is good at looking after people. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/momo_hina/kouen/index.html]Official Site[/url]]

[spoiler]It is implied that she actually sees her son in a sexual light after enjoying sex with a man while in front of her sleeping son.[/spoiler]
